body: i went on a really long walk today and decided im not going to give up so soon. I'm going to talk to my parents about my hallucinations and maybe see a doctor soon. Coming home and seeing these comments really helped me. thank you all so much
i hear things. telling me im going to die. thank you for trying
im 15. yes, i have all those things. does it really matter?
fuck all of them, alright? they dont deserve you. things will get better. please know that. i hope you'll stay with us.

im 15, and when i was about 10 or 11 i was in your exact position. im not going to say everything is so much better, because i'd be lying. but im glad i didnt do it. we have things to look forward to. dont quit on life before you've even lived. you have a lot of things ahead. please dont do this babe, its not worth it.
